reason: Document B prompts the applicant to answer the exact questions I will have for the grants committee: what specific system changed so I don't have to chase their report for four months again, and how they will pay for fuel and insurance after spending down their reserves to $11,000. Both documents smartly corrected the math to show a realistic 12.5% annual increase rather than an unsupported claim of doubling fresh food, but Document A's bare apology without a plan leaves too many red flags for a $50,000 capital grant.
